mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId, intent_id AS intentId, source_request_id AS sourceRequestId, payload_json AS payload, attempt_count AS attempts, lease_version AS leaseVersion FROM ( SELECT tenant_id, intent_id, source_request_id, payload_json, attempt_count, lease_version, created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tenant_id ORDER BY created_at, intent_id) tenant_rank FROM mk_award_intent_outbox WHERE delivery_mode = 'CENTER' AND ((status_name = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status_name = 'SENDING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now}))) ) ranked WHERE tenant_rank <= #{tenantLimit} ORDER BY created_at, intent_id LIMIT #{totalLimit}
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_award_intent_outbox SET status_name = 'SENDING', lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, lease_version = lease_version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND intent_id = #{intentId} AND lease_version = #{expectedLeaseVersion} AND delivery_mode = 'CENTER' AND ((status_name = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status_name = 'SENDING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now})))
